book_t.book_t_title: Root of the Powers of Fire
book_t.book_t_summary: The root of Fire is presented as natural force: strength, rush, vigor, and energy in works and questions governed by its nature.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: Of the Aces - Ace of Wands

book_t.book_t_title: Root of the Powers of the Waters
book_t.book_t_summary: The root of Water is described through flowing water and lotuses, symbolizing fertility, productiveness, beauty, pleasure, and happiness.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: Of the Aces - Ace of Cups

book_t.book_t_title: Root of the Powers of the Air
book_t.book_t_summary: The root of Air represents invoked force and great power for good or evil, with strength through trouble and justice upholding authority.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: Of the Aces - Ace of Swords

book_t.book_t_title: Root of the Powers of Earth
book_t.book_t_summary: The root of Earth represents materiality in good and evil senses, including material gain, labor, power, and wealth.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: Of the Aces - Ace of Pentacles

book_t.decan_dignity: Saturn in detriment in Leo (Leo is ruled by the Sun; Saturn rules the opposite sign Aquarius)
book_t.book_t_summary: Depicts forceful conflict: boldness and violent struggle that may show as cruelty or generosity according to dignity.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Wands - 5 of Wands

book_t.decan_dignity: Jupiter has no major essential dignity or debility in Leo
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows victory after strife: gain, pleasure won by labor, sociability and care to avoid conflict, with pride possible by dignity.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Wands - 6 of Wands

book_t.decan_dignity: Mars has no major essential dignity or debility in Leo
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows victory possible through energy and courage amid opposition, obstacles, and quarrelling.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Wands - 7 of Wands

book_t.decan_dignity: Sun has no major essential dignity or debility in Virgo
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows prudence in small matters: skill, careful labor, small gains, hoarding and lack of larger enterprise.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Pentacles - 8 of Pentacles

book_t.decan_dignity: Venus in fall in Virgo
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows complete material gain: riches or inheritance, with covetousness or knavery possible by dignity.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Pentacles - 9 of Pentacles

book_t.decan_dignity: Mercury in domicile in Virgo
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows completion of material fortune at its pinnacle, with wealth, heaviness, and cleverness in money matters.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Pentacles - 10 of Pentacles

book_t.decan_dignity: Moon has no major essential dignity or debility in Libra
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows peace restored through tension: strength from suffering, truce, arrangement, justice, and mixed truth and untruth.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Swords - 2 of Swords

book_t.decan_dignity: Saturn in exaltation in Libra
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows disruption and sorrow: separation, quarrelling, discord and tears, with dignity modifying the outcome.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Swords - 3 of Swords

book_t.decan_dignity: Jupiter has no major essential dignity or debility in Libra
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows rest after strife: quiet, recovery, ease and abundance following sorrow or struggle.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Swords - 4 of Swords

book_t.decan_dignity: Mars in domicile in Scorpio
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows the end of expected pleasure: disappointment, loss, treachery, and anxieties from unexpected sources.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Cups - 5 of Cups

book_t.decan_dignity: Sun has no major essential dignity or debility in Scorpio
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows the beginning of steady increase and pleasure, with success or enjoyment only at its commencement.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Cups - 6 of Cups

book_t.decan_dignity: Venus in detriment in Scorpio
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows apparent but unstable victory: deception, unfulfilled promises, dissipation, and success not followed up.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Cups - 7 of Cups

book_t.decan_dignity: Mercury in detriment in Sagittarius
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows force applied suddenly: rapid action, swiftness, courage and boldness, but not lasting and dignity-dependent.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Wands - 8 of Wands

book_t.decan_dignity: Moon has no major essential dignity or debility in Sagittarius
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows tremendous steady force, strength and recovery, with success after apprehension and strife.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Wands - 9 of Wands

book_t.decan_dignity: Saturn has no major essential dignity or debility in Sagittarius
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows overbearing force aimed at material or selfish ends, with failure from excessive opposition or, when well dignified, self-sacrifice.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Wands - 10 of Wands

book_t.decan_dignity: Jupiter in fall in Capricorn
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows harmonious change: alternating gain and loss, shifting occupation, travel, prudence and inconsistency.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Pentacles - 2 of Pentacles

book_t.decan_dignity: Mars in exaltation in Capricorn
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows constructive material work: building, increase, commercial gain, influence and the start of matters later established.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Pentacles - 3 of Pentacles

book_t.decan_dignity: Sun has no major essential dignity or debility in Capricorn
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows assured material gain and earthly power: completed success that tends not to develop further.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Pentacles - 4 of Pentacles

book_t.decan_dignity: Venus has no major essential dignity or debility in Aquarius
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows contest decided against the person: defeat, trouble, loss, malice and separation, with cleverness also noted.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Swords - 5 of Swords

book_t.decan_dignity: Mercury has no major essential dignity or debility in Aquarius
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows success earned after anxiety and trouble, with labor, patience, journeying by water, and self-regard.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Swords - 6 of Swords

book_t.decan_dignity: Moon has no major essential dignity or debility in Aquarius
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows partial success and effort abandoned near victory, with unreliable or vacillating tendencies.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Swords - 7 of Swords

book_t.decan_dignity: Saturn has no major essential dignity or debility in Pisces
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows temporary success without lasting result, with interest declining after the thing is gained.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Cups - 8 of Cups

book_t.decan_dignity: Jupiter in domicile in Pisces
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows nearly complete realization of pleasure and happiness, with self-praise or vanity possible by dignity.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Cups - 9 of Cups

book_t.decan_dignity: Mars has no major essential dignity or debility in Pisces
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows lasting success and happiness inspired from above, with pleasure, peace-making, kindness, or waste by dignity.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Cups - 10 of Cups

book_t.decan_dignity: Mars in domicile in Aries
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows strength and rule: domination, courage, ambition, and proud resolution, with obstinacy or revenge possible by dignity.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Wands - 2 of Wands

book_t.decan_dignity: Sun in exaltation in Aries
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows established force and completed labor: strength, hope realized, success after struggle, and pride or insolence by dignity.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Wands - 3 of Wands

book_t.decan_dignity: Venus in detriment in Aries
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows perfected work and rest after labor: completion, settlement, mirth and success, with possible instability through haste.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Wands - 4 of Wands

book_t.decan_dignity: Mercury has no major essential dignity or debility in Taurus
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows material trouble: loss of money or position, toil, poverty and care, with possible recovery through labor.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Pentacles - 5 of Pentacles

book_t.decan_dignity: Moon in exaltation in Taurus
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows success and gain in material undertakings, including influence, rank, prosperity, liberality and justice.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Pentacles - 6 of Pentacles

book_t.decan_dignity: Saturn has no major essential dignity or debility in Taurus
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows promises of success unfulfilled: apparent gains without fruit, disappointment and labor with little result.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Pentacles - 7 of Pentacles

book_t.decan_dignity: Jupiter in detriment in Gemini
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows force narrowed into small matters: restriction, detail-work, pettiness or patient study according to dignity.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Swords - 8 of Swords

book_t.decan_dignity: Mars has no major essential dignity or debility in Gemini
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows despair and cruelty: suffering, malice, loss and oppression, with faithfulness or patience possible by dignity.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Swords - 9 of Swords

book_t.decan_dignity: Sun has no major essential dignity or debility in Gemini
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows complete disruption and failure of plans, an undisciplined force ending in ruin, with eloquence possible by dignity.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Swords - 10 of Swords

book_t.decan_dignity: Venus has no major essential dignity or debility in Cancer
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows harmonious union of masculine and feminine, pleasure and mirth, with waste or folly when ill dignified.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Cups - 2 of Cups

book_t.decan_dignity: Mercury has no major essential dignity or debility in Cancer
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows overflowing plenty and passive success: pleasure, good fortune, gladness, kindness and liberality.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Cups - 3 of Cups

book_t.decan_dignity: Moon in domicile in Cancer
book_t.book_t_summary: Shows pleasure near a stationary point or decline, receiving pleasure with some discomfort and possible drawbacks.

source.primary: Regardie, The Golden Dawn (Llewellyn 6th ed.), Book T section
source.section_label: Book T: The Suit of Cups - 4 of Cups
